items.title: Book marker in every item list: read, carried or nothing new, with status and tooltip
items.verify: Version 3 installed on the owner's machine: the game reaches the main menu; in the inventory (I) a read book shows the tick and '/ READ', an unread book with new content shows '/ UNREAD' and its tooltip lists what is new, one with nothing new shows '/ NOTHING NEW'; a merchant and the storage chest behave as in version 2; a looted container shows the tick and the status after a book's name. Refresh after reading: reading a book in the inventory updates its row (and other copies) as soon as the book closes, without the list jumping to the top, and an equipped sword stays equipped. Trade and storage: books in Geralt's own list show the tick when read or nothing new. Loot window and the preview next to a container: a read book shows its icon with the inventory's tick drawn on it (w2ef_read icons), status text after the name in the loot window.
items.evidence: docs/fixes/shop-book-read-marker.md - version 1 (read or carried) confirmed in game 2026-10-30; version 2's shop/storage behaviour was confirmed there too. Version 3 (2026-10-31) moved the marker into CGuiUtils.FillItemObject (with a 'merchant' context argument) and wrapped the loot window's name and icon pushes in container_class.ws. Dry run on the vanilla and the Mersey/HD UI archives: DZIP hash valid, only guiutils.ws/guishop.ws/container_class.ws differ, every declared name checked against the compiler's keywords (caught 'state'), uninstall restores all files byte-identically. In-game result pending. The loot window has no tooltip (ui_loot.swf imports only xfontlib.swf), so there the status goes after the item name. check_texts.py still passes for all 12 languages. Owner confirmed the inventory marker in game but it only updated after reopening the inventory; 2026-10-31 ExamineItem refills the list (W2EF_RefillAfterReading in guiinventory.ws, scroll kept), dry run and v3 -> new upgrade on both archives byte-identical on uninstall, in-game test pending. Review found the trade/storage player list's tick is cleared by CompareInventories; that statement is now a same-length no-op too ($SwfPatches), byte diff and disassembly checked in all four movies, every other item window checked (none else can hold a book). Owner's loot test: the tick hid the book icon and the preview had none; ui_loot.swf icon field widened (RECT, 2 bytes) and hud.swf's preview name set as htmlText (1 byte), unknown movies now skipped with their dependent script edits (NeedsSwf); dry run, fallback, upgrade and uninstall verified. Second loot test: preview tick shown but a long name lost its second line, loot icon still wrapped away; Scaleform lays out inline. Now the icon field is 40 px wider with a right-aligned line, the preview tick 10 px and its name field 4 px taller. Third test: preview fine, loot tick drifted to the window edge; replaced by generated read icons (book icon + alreadyread_64x64 overlay at 90%, 152 books, built by the patcher from the game's files), the ui_loot/hud SWF edits dropped and restored on upgrade; dry run, upgrade and uninstall verified. Owner confirmed the read icons in game. Final form: tick only for read (or carried at a merchant/chest), loot window text only '(Nothing new)'.

items.title: Apply the script patches from the DLL (no .bat/.ps1 in the release)
items.verify: Plan tasks 1-9: research trace answered (Q1-Q6), golden test equal to ScriptPatches.ps1, owner start test and in-game check of BookMarker/Continue/PauseQuit with the DLL only, release zip without scripts, Nexus scan not quarantined.
items.evidence: Nexus quarantined 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 (VirusTotal 8/68 and 7/67, BitDefender Heur.BZC.PZQ.Boxter on the PowerShell patcher); W1's script-free zip scans 1/66. See docs/local/nexus.md. Task 1 (research) done 2026-10-31 on branch dll-script-patches: docs/fixes/dll-script-patches.md, raw excerpts in docs/validation/file-trace-2026-10-31.md. All 14 trace hooks were in place at t=+0 ms (the loader fills the original IAT before DllMain); first CookedPC access at +235 ms. Archives are found by the CookedPC\*.dzip glob and opened by absolute path; UI movies are opened loose by absolute path after a failing relative FindFirstFileExW probe, icons the same without a probe; a loose file that does not exist is never looked up by path, so new files must be entries of a redirected archive (branch B); sizes come from the find data (archives) and GetFileSize on the handle (movies and icons, twice per open); no CreateFileMappingW and no ANSI variants. Task 2 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_common.{c,h} + src/sp_dzip.{c,h} (DZIP v2 reader/writer, port of the .ps1 Dzip class) and tools/patchtest (harness built as build\sptest.exe because UAC installer detection elevates any manifest-less 32-bit exe whose name contains "patch"). All 6 tests pass, also against the owner's install: 23 archives / 31999 entries opened with the table hash verified (pack0.dzip table-only) and 612 entries of the 12 small archives decoded. Writer additions vs the reference: it patches the entry count at +8 (the .ps1 only replaces), caps an entry at 512 MB, and clamps an over-long LZF literal run (dlc_finishers.dzip has a 2-byte entry with a 16-byte literal run, which the reference's Buffer.BlockCopy would throw on). Task 3 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_swf.{c,h} (CWS->FWS through vendored tinf 1.2.1 in src/third_party/tinf, wildcard pattern search, same-length apply, SP_SWF_COMPARE) with 4 new tests. swf_real passes on 4 real movies: the HD UI originals in the old patcher backup and the abetterui.dzip copies are ORIGINAL. The four pattern arrays were checked against $SwfCompare by evaluating the .ps1 in PowerShell: 33/33/29/29 bytes identical. Task 4 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_dds.{c,h} (Decode64 for DXT1/3/5 and 32-bit, Over with .NET ties-to-even rounding, Encode64 A8R8G8B8) with 4 tests. dds_decode_dxt5 covers both DXT5 alpha branches (the real alreadyread overlay uses a0 < a1), dds_roundtrip proves decode is exact and encode writes the same file, dds_over pins 7 alpha-over cases, and dds_real_overlay decodes the real DXT5 overlay from abetterui.dzip to the reference pixels (FNV-1a64 760A865CFC2814EC from an independent Python port of the .ps1). Open point for Task 6: sp_dzip_open takes the archive in memory, but pack0.dzip is 10.5 GB and holds 1099 item icons and 63 def_*.xml, so Task 6 needs a file-backed reader; noted in the plan. Task 5 done 2026-10-31: src/scriptpatches/ holds edits.txt (the 14 $FeatureList rows) and the nine .ws fragments verbatim, plus book_texts.ws generated once by the reference New-TextFunction; src/scriptpatches.rc embeds them as RCDATA under the numeric IDs in src/sp_script_ids.h (rc turns a quoted name into part of the name, so file names cannot be resource names). src/sp_script.{c,h} ports Add-Edit/ConvertTo-Tabs/Get-CollectBody/New-ReadIconFunction with all-or-nothing per feature, a per-feature marker guard and whitespace-flexible literal anchors; build.bat and tools\patchtest\build.bat compile the .rc into the DLL and the harness. build\sptest.exe test --game: 20 tests, 0 failures; script_real applies all 14 rows to the five real 3.5.0.26 scripts (from the old patcher backup) with block counts 2/1/6/6/2, and the port output equals the reference output on those five files byte for byte (224 019 bytes, Latin-1, same book list) - a local check that Task 6's golden test makes permanent. Details in docs/fixes/dll-script-patches.md. Task 6 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_overlay.{c,h} (cache key, Get-ReadIcons, Build-Scripts, Get-PatchedSwf, Branch B archive entries, redirect table), the file-backed DZIP reader sp_dzip_file_* (pack0.dzip is 10.5 GB; new dzip_file test compares it with the in-memory path over all 23 archives), the harness build command and tools\patchtest\golden.py. GOLDEN OK: the reference on a scratch layout (old patcher backup = Project Mersey + HD UI; hard links for the other dzips) and build\sptest.exe build on an identical layout give byte-identical results - 460 base_scripts.dzip entries, 152 read-book icons (archive entries vs loose files, both directions) and ui_trade.swf/ui_storage.swf; the second build logs cache: reused and changes no file. No vanilla archive at hand: Mersey only, noted in the fix doc. Overlay build ~110 ms, cache reuse 16 ms. build\sptest.exe test --game: 22 tests, 0 failures. Task 7 Step 1 done 2026-10-31: src/sp_hooks.{c,h} (redirect table, one build per session on the first target touch under a critical section, find-data redirect), enginefix.c ([scriptpatches] keys default 1, script_dirs, scripthooks_thread installing CreateFileW/FindFirstFileW/FindNextFileW, redirect chained into hook_CreateFileW, find data into the two find hooks), build.bat now links src\sp_*.c and tinf into the DLL, [scriptpatches] documented in dist-files\witcher2_enginefix.ini. cmd /c build.bat builds; build\sptest.exe test --game 22 tests, 0 failures; golden.py still GOLDEN OK; a local hooks harness on the golden scratch layout proved the build trigger, the find size (4 508 633 = cached archive), the 3 redirects, case-insensitive matching and that unrelated paths stay untouched.
